clusters.headline: Acetyl fentanyl is turning up more often in Cook County's drug supply
clusters.summary: The Cook County Medical Examiner identified acetyl fentanyl in 13 of the 163 opioid-involved deaths it examined in the 90 days to 30 June. That is 8% of them, against 2% over the year before that. Toxicology runs about 7 weeks behind, so this describes what has been in the supply recently rather than what is in it right now.

clusters.title: 4-Methyl-N,N-dimethylcathinone (4-MDMC) newly detected in West Coast samples
clusters.body: NIST RaDAR: 4-Methyl-N,N-dimethylcathinone (4-MDMC), described by the program as synthetic cathinone, was newly detected in West Coast samples collected in April 2026. in a single West Coast sample that contained no other compounds. Samples are voluntarily submitted and may not be representative of broader trends within the United States drug supply.
